description: Codex project hook bridge. It executes the canonical Claude-first runner from the repository git root; no hook code is copied under .codex/.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') PreToolUse"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') PostToolUse"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') SessionStart"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') UserPromptSubmit"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') Stop"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & node (Join-Path $root 'mcp\claude-userlevel\hooks\runner.js') SubagentStart"
